title: INVAR-Agri: Detecting Discrepancies in Multilingual Operator Manuals of Agricultural Implements with a Fine-Tuned LLM
abstract: arXiv:2610.35423v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Operator manuals of agricultural implements are delivered in many languages, and the standards require that competent persons review every translation, which makes this review the bottleneck. This paper presents a proof of concept that compares two training workflows on the same LLM, EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct, trained on operator manuals of one manufacturer. In approach A, a back-translator translates each language version back into English, and an English reader compares it with the English version. In approach B, a checker reads the English version and the translation together, where the checker reports differences. The test sets contain errors planted in numbers, units, opposite words, obligations, negations, and conditions in 24 languages, and they include unmodified text and meaning-preserving edits for alerts and false alarms. translated_title: INVAR-Agri：使用微调大语言模型检测农业机械多语言操作手册中的差异
translated_abstract: 农业机械的操作手册以多种语言发布，而标准要求由有资质的人员审查每一个译本，这使审查成为瓶颈环节。本文提出了一个概念验证，在同一大语言模型 EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct 上，基于一家制造商的操作手册训练并比较两种工作流程。在方法 A 中，回译器将每种语言版本翻译回英语，由英语阅读器将其与英语原版进行对比；在方法 B 中，检查器同时阅读英语版本和译文并报告两者之间的差异。测试集涵盖 24 种语言，在其中植入涉及数字、单位、反义词、义务性表述、否定和条件等类型的错误，同时包含未修改的文本和保留原意的编辑内容，用于测试误报情况。经训练的回译器掩盖了许多植入的错误，尤其是被弱化的义务性表述，而翻译……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 INVAR-Agri 概念验证，在 EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct 上训练并比较“回译后对比”与“双语直接检查”两种微调工作流程，以在 24 种语言的农业机械操作手册中自动检测涉及数字、单位、义务、否定和条件的翻译差异。
en_tdlr: This proof-of-concept, INVAR-Agri, fine-tunes EuroLLM-1.7B-Instruct on agricultural operator manuals and compares two workflows—back-translation with English comparison versus direct bilingual checking—to automatically detect planted translation discrepancies across 24 languages.
